ios.desc:
Learn music theory through interactive lessons, challenges, and ear training that actually stick.
Cadence: Guitar Theory helps you understand the fretboard, hear the music, and play with more creativity and confidence through visuals, sound, and smart repetition.

- Interactive Lessons
Structured 5 to 10 screen lessons combine visual fretboard diagrams and audio playback to make complex theory intuitive. Learn chords, scales, intervals, and progressions step by step without dry textbooks.

- Intuitive Recaps
Each lesson ends with a single-page flashcard recap that condenses all key concepts for quick, visual review. Perfect for short practice sessions or refreshing theory on the go.

- Playful Challenges
Turn theory into a game. Practice with theory, visual, and audio challenges that increase in difficulty as you improve. Earn trophies, build streaks, and train your brain and fingers to think musically.

- Ear Training
Sharpen your musical intuition through sound-backed lessons and dedicated audio challenges that teach you to recognize intervals, chords, scales, and progressions by ear.

- Progress Tracking
Stay motivated with daily activity reports, streaks, and global completion tracking. See your growth clearly and stay focused on your goals.

- Complete Guitar Library
Explore a vast collection of more than 2000 chords, scales, arpeggios, and progressions. Includes CAGED, 3NPS, and octave patterns with optional voicing suggestions to help you master the fretboard.


Privacy policy: https://cadenceguitar.com/privacy-policy/
Terms & Conditions: https://cadenceguitar.com/terms-and-conditions/

show_hn.title: Show HN: Cadence – A guitar theory app

quotes.text:
Hello HN, I just released this music theory and ear training mobile app for guitar which I've been working on for a bit more than a year on the side.

The idea was to make something for the eternally "intermediate" guitarist (myself included). There are a lot of beginner apps which rely on learning songs, toolkits which give you a bunch of stuff with no explanation but not many in-between apps to actually learn and practice more generic and somewhat advanced stuff.

The app contains short lessons, recaps and most importantly challenges (visual, audio and pure theory) along with a very complete library.

The challenges are made for practicing, they will get increasingly harder and getting to the max score is supposed to be quite hard. The idea being that you have to repeat them regularly until your brain has integrated the info and it flows naturally rather than being a one time quick dopamine shot. This is partly inspired by how language learning apps work.

It has no ads, a lifetime purchase option and you can use it without an account if you don't care about multi-device sync or backing up your progress.

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.apizon.cadence.android

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cadence-guitar-theory/id6747011447?platform=iphone

(This is my second and last post about this sorry for spam. My first post a few weeks ago didn't get any views and posting on a saturday might not have helped...)
